reason: My doctor only said my magnesium could be low, she didn't tell me to take anything. I'd get the blood test first, and if I do need it I'd ask her what to buy rather than pick a TikTok Shop box.
objection: $29.99 a month is more than Toplux or Goli and I'm not even sure I need magnesium. The lab report is nice, but a report on their own batch doesn't tell me a supplement will do anything for me.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor confirming my magnesium is low and saying this kind of magnesium is fine to take, at around $20 a month or less.
